app.title: agentoo
app.subtitle: Run Claude agents against your projects.

health.outdatedMessage: This tab is running an older build than the server. Reload to pick up the latest version.

form.heading: Add a project
form.name: Name
form.sshKeyHint: Needed for a private repository over ssh. Only applies to git@… and ssh:// remotes.
form.sshKeyEmptyHint: No keys yet. If this repository is private, generate one on the SSH keys page and add it to your git host as a deploy key first.
form.folderTip: Only folders in this directory can be added. To bring a project onto the server, copy it here — with scp or rsync, say — then reload this page.
form.emptyHint: Creates an empty git repository in the projects directory. Useful for starting something new with an agent.

delete.confirmClone: Delete "{{name}}" and remove its files from the server?
delete.confirmExisting: Remove "{{name}}"? The folder in the sources directory is yours and will be left alone.
delete.title: Delete project?

recovery.heading: Setup could not authenticate
recovery.keyExplain: SSH is never anonymous — GitHub and GitLab require a key on their ssh endpoint even for a public repository. Pick a key that has been added to the host as a deploy key, or create one first.
recovery.noKeysYet: No keys yet — generate one, then add it to the host as a deploy key.
recovery.httpsExplain: If the repository is public, https needs no credential at all and is the simpler fix. This rewrites the remote and clears the key.
recovery.manualExplain: Clone it over SSH yourself, where git can prompt you for a passphrase, then check again. Anything already present at the target path is adopted rather than re-cloned.
recovery.checkAgain: I did the manual steps — check again

projects.keyRetryHint: Changing the key does not re-clone.
projects.branchHint: Brought up to date from the remote right before each new session's worktree is cut. Leave blank to use whatever branch is currently checked out.
projects.branchChangeFailed: Could not change the default branch

overview.retryHint: Re-runs setup. An already-cloned repository is adopted rather than cloned again.
overview.deleteCloneHint: Deletes the project and removes its files from the server.
overview.deleteExistingHint: Removes the project. The folder in the sources directory is yours and is left alone.

sshKeys.heading: Your keys
sshKeys.intro: Keys are generated as ed25519 with no passphrase, because the server clones unattended and nobody is there to type one. Only the public half is ever shown or returned by the API — the private key stays on disk, readable only by the service account.
sshKeys.empty: No keys yet. Generate one above if you need to clone a private repository.
sshKeys.deleteConfirm: Delete the key "{{name}}"? Projects using it fall back to ssh defaults.

form.heading: Generate a key
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Becomes the filename. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
form.commentHint: Goes into the key as a label. An email is conventional.

errors.nameChars: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only; must start with a letter or digit

steps.copy: Copy the public key and add it to your git host as a deploy key (GitHub: repo → Settings → Deploy keys).
steps.test: Press Test to confirm the host accepts it.
steps.use: Select the key when adding a project with an ssh remote.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.empty: No sessions yet. Create one above — it gets its own git worktree and branch, so it will not collide with anything else running on this project.
sessions.deleteConfirm: Delete this session? Its worktree is removed, but the branch is kept so the work is not lost.

form.heading: New session
form.title: Title
form.baseBranchWillUseOverride: Will start this session from "{{branch}}" instead of the project default.
form.baseBranchWillUseDefault: Will start from the project's default branch, "{{branch}}".
form.baseBranchWillUseAuto: No default branch is set for this project — will start from the repository's current branch.
form.orchestratorHint: The agent that drives this session and delegates to subagents.
form.orchestratorEmpty: No orchestrator agents in the library yet. Add one with role: orchestrator.
form.budgetHint: Optional hard ceiling for the whole session, passed to the SDK. Subagent requests count towards it.
form.notReady: The project has to finish setup first.

sessions.willQueue: A turn is running — this will be sent as soon as it finishes
sessions.composerPlaceholder: Tell the orchestrator what to do…
sessions.needsOrchestrator: This session has no orchestrator, so it cannot run. Set one from the sessions list.

attachments.tooLargeForSession: Too large for what's left of this session's storage limit
attachments.blockingSend_one: Waiting for {{count}} upload to finish before this can be sent
attachments.blockingSend_other: Waiting for {{count}} uploads to finish before this can be sent

transcript.empty: Nothing yet. Send a message to start the session.

notFound.message: There is nothing at this address.

library.intro: Agents and skills live here once and are used by any project you select them for. Editing one changes it everywhere it is used — that is the point of a shared library rather than per-project copies.
library.noAgents: No agents yet. An agent is a role — an orchestrator that plans and delegates, or a specialist it delegates to.
library.noSkills: No skills yet. A skill is knowledge an agent can pull in when it is relevant.

roleHint.orchestrator: Can drive a session. Gets the autonomy guarantee, and the orchestration method unless you turn the team off below.
roleHint.subagent: Only reachable by delegation from an orchestrator; never drives a session itself.

agent.name: Name
agent.nameHint: Becomes the filename. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Cannot be changed later.

teamHint.on: Composed with the library’s orchestration method and told to delegate the work rather than do it.
teamHint.off: A solo agent: it gets neither the method nor the delegation instruction, and does the work itself.

agent.descriptionPlaceholder: Reviews a change for correctness bugs. Read-only.
agent.descriptionHint: How Claude decides when to use this agent. Write it as a trigger, not a title.
agent.restrictTools: Restrict which tools this agent may use
agent.toolsHint: Leave off to inherit every tool available to subagents. A tool left out is not in the agent's session at all — it works without it rather than asking permission.
agent.promptPlaceholder: You review changes for defects that would actually bite…
agent.promptHint: The agent's system prompt. A subagent starts with a fresh context and sees nothing of the parent conversation, so say what it needs to know here.
agent.promptHintOrchestrator: The agent's system prompt. Anthropic's delegation guidance is appended automatically for orchestrators — you do not need to write it.
agent.deleteConfirm: Delete the agent "{{name}}"? It is also removed from every project using it.
agent.renameHint: Changing this renames the file and re-points every project using it.

skill.name: Name
skill.nameHint: Becomes the directory name. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
skill.descriptionPlaceholder: How this project runs and writes tests.
skill.descriptionHint: How Claude decides when this skill is relevant.
skill.bodyHint: The markdown body. Files bundled beside it are managed over SSH and are left untouched by this editor.
skill.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill "{{name}}"? It is also removed from every project using it.
skill.deleteConfirmWithFiles: Delete the skill "{{name}}"? The whole directory goes, including: {{files}}
skill.renameHint: Changing this renames the directory and re-points every project using it.

assign.intro: Pick the agents and skills this project should use. They are symlinked beside the repository, never into it, so your working tree stays clean.
assign.hint: Changes apply to the next session; a running one keeps what it started with.

delete.agentConfirm: "{{name}}" will be deleted, and unlinked from {{count}} project(s) using it. This cannot be undone.
delete.skillConfirm: "{{name}}" and its {{files}} bundled file(s) will be deleted, and unlinked from {{count}} project(s) using it. This cannot be undone.

picker.heading: Choose a project for this tab
picker.lead: Open one of your projects here, or add a new one. This tab keeps whatever you choose.
picker.none: No projects yet — add your first one below.
picker.notReady: This project is not ready to open yet.

settings.heading: Configuration
settings.lead: Preferences for this installation, stored in your browser.
settings.themeHint: Light or dark colours throughout the app.

storage.heading: Storage
storage.lead: Attachment usage across every session, and the reconciliation job that keeps the database and the disk in agreement.
storage.loadFailed: Could not load the storage summary

topSessions.heading: Largest sessions
topSessions.empty: No session has any attachments yet.

storage.noCheckYet: No check has ever run yet, so these anomalies may be out of date — use "Run check now" below.
storage.cleanupCountsFailed: Could not load exact counts for cleanup

cleanupConfirm.title: Clean up storage?
cleanupConfirm.body: Deletes {{blobs}} orphan file(s), {{rows}} dangling row(s), {{dirs}} orphan session director(y/ies) and {{mismatches}} checksum mismatch(es) found by the last check — {{bytes}} in total. A checksum mismatch deletes both the corrupt blob and its row.
cleanupConfirm.empty: Nothing to clean up — the last check found no anomalies to remove.

anomalies.heading: Anomalies

resolveConfirm.title: Resolve this anomaly?
resolveConfirm.body: Dismisses it without deleting anything. If it is still genuinely present, the next check reopens it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this anomaly?
deleteConfirm.body: Deletes the orphan blob, dangling row or orphan session directory this anomaly names — or, for a checksum mismatch, both the corrupt blob and its row. This cannot be undone.

anomalies.resolveSelectedFailed: Could not resolve the selected anomalies

resolveSelectedConfirm.title: Resolve the selected anomalies?
resolveSelectedConfirm.body: Dismisses {{count}} selected anomaly/anomalies, without deleting anything.

anomalies.deleteSelectedFailed: Could not delete the selected anomalies

deleteSelectedConfirm.title: Delete the selected anomalies?
deleteSelectedConfirm.body: Deletes what each of the {{count}} selected anomaly/anomalies names. This cannot be undone.

outcome.revalidated: No longer an anomaly — nothing was deleted
